issue_context.title: options.defaultEncoding not validated in stream.Writable constructor
comments: I'll open a PR to validate encodings

There is this comment in writable streams (but its also in readable).

https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/762a3a8ad925d56a12b43e0e7f7c811e93097784/lib/internal/streams/writable.js#L121-L126

@mcollina @ronag can give more context on why `defaultEncoding` is not validated and whether to add some validation.
On the other end readable `encoding` will throw because of `StringDecoder`:

https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/762a3a8ad925d56a12b43e0e7f7c811e93097784/lib/internal/streams/readable.js#L177-L184
I don't think there is any specific reason why it's not validated. PR welcome.

review_comments: You should also add a test for passing null, and clarify if it should throw error or not.
I'll add a test with falsy value,it should no throw but go into default `utf8` as before
With that suggestion, we would no longer skip the `Buffer.isEncoding` call for the default value, so I don't think we should commit it.
